text:
maya: Heads-up: running a dress rehearsal Thurs 10:30 PT for the SDK v4 rollout (removes X-Client header, enforces strict envelope). Need Partners, Eng-Platform, Support, and SI PM present. Goal: validate partner-facing errors and rollback.
diego: I can lead the runtime side. Planning to flip the strict-envelope flag in staging and run a 30min steady-state then inject a header-mismatch.
tara: Support will run the live chat triage and exercise the canned KB. Please post the short customer-facing blurb so we can practice sending it.
li: Ops will simulate regional failover + dedicated pool fallback. Will also run a mismatch of SDK 4 client sending old batch param `items` -> should surface deprecation warning first, then fail.
alex-si: SI PM here  (assigned) . I'll coordinate with our systems integrator partner for the canary org: org-canary-7. Want the rehearsal to include partner observability handoff.
marketplace-bot: schedule: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/2195001234 (invite sent). export: https://redwood.internal/partners/export?org=org-canary-7
maya: Draft quick checklist:
- Flip feature flag: sdk_v4_strict_envelope -> true in staging
- Send 3 test payloads from SDK v3 and v4 (headers: X-Client: v3/v4)
- Inject deprecated batch param `items` and confirm deprecation header X-Warn: batch-deprecated
- Trigger region failover and confirm routing to Dedicated fallback pool
- Verify HTTP codes: 200+warning for soft deprecations; 4xx with structured error for hard rejects
- Run rollback (feature-flag off) and measure time to restore
diego: Add telemetry verification: traces should include tags: partner_org, sdk_version, route_hint. Ill add a small tracing span that marks compatibility-check.
tara: Copy for KB (short notice):
"We are running a brief compatibility rehearsal with select partners to validate SDK v4 behavior. You may see transient 4xx or deprecation warnings. No action required unless you receive repeated errors; contact support with trace id."
maya: Good. Also prepare an abbreviated RCA template we can send to partners post-sim.
li: ops commands for the sim (for runbook):
```
# toggle flag
redwood-cli flags set sdk_v4_strict_envelope true --env=staging
# quick curl from partner org
curl -i -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ORG_CANARY_KEY' \
  -H 'X-Client: v3' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-encoder-v3","items":[{"prompt":"test"}]}'
```
marketplace-bot: reminder: please upload canary org contact (ops contact + SI PM) to the event.
diego: Also, test that runtime returns X-Rollback-Token in responses so Support can trigger an automated rollback if needed.
alex-si: SI will watch their integration logs and validate error envelope parsing; will confirm in thread after run.
maya: Final asks: Diego  add telemetry check link; Tara  prepare KB snippet and quick response templates by Wed EOD; Li  publish runbook excerpt to /ops/partner-rehearsals; Alex  confirm partner contact.
tara: Will prepare KB + chat templates.
diego: Pushed telemetry checks to https://redwood.internal/docs/telemetry/sdk-compat-checks (read-only).
li: Runbook excerpt uploaded: /ops/partner-rehearsals/runbook-org-canary-7.md
alex-si: Partner contact confirmed. I'll be on the call.
maya: Great. See you Thursday. :white_check_mark:
